jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Forus is building an AI-powered network that connects doctors, pharmacies, payers, and biopharma to accelerate new science to patients.

Our platform automates the complexity between a doctor prescribing a medicine and a patient starting treatment, including insurance coverage, financial assistance, and supply chain navigation. We provide this support free to doctors and patients, helping them get life-changing medicine faster, cheaper, and easier. The resulting network enables biopharma companies to design better research, launch new drugs more effectively, and invest in harder-to-treat conditions.

Forus has exceptional product-market fit and is growing rapidly through organic adoption:

 - Accelerating scale: We already support patients across more than 85% of ZIP codes and partner with 9 of top 15 largest biopharma companies in the world.

 - AI-native, durable model: Our business becomes stronger as AI improves, as every new doctor, patient, and partner makes the network more valuable.

 - Backing to build for the long term: We raised $300M+ from leading investors to build an exceptional team and unlock the full scale of the opportunity.

Our number one priority is scaling to market demand. We are looking for individuals who are high horsepower, high throughput, and hyper resourceful to help us increase capacity and grow. We move fast and need to move faster.

If we succeed, science will be the only limit to medicine.

All full-time roles are in person in New York.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a member of the Strategy & Operations team, you will help solve some of the most important problems facing the company. You will take end responsibility for goals across growth, operations, product, partnerships, and new business initiatives, helping define strategy and drive execution. This role is crucial to ensuring Forus can scale to meet exponentially growing user and client demand.

This is a highly generalist role designed for people who want broad exposure to building a rapidly growing company. Over time, team members often develop deep expertise in a particular area of the business and go on to help build new functions, lead major initiatives, or take ownership of critical parts of the company. Success requires a combination of structured problem-solving, strong execution, and a willingness to take ownership wherever the business needs it most.

This is a demanding role, with a high level of autonomy and responsibility. You will be expected to "act like an owner" and commit yourself to Forus' success. If you are low-ego, hungry to learn, and excited about intense, impactful work that drives both company growth and accelerated career progression, we want to hear from you.




IF YOU JOIN, YOU WILL:

 - Own high-priority initiatives from problem definition through execution across growth, operations, partnerships, product, and other areas of the business

 - Help develop and scale critical functions as the company grows, identifying opportunities to improve performance, efficiency, and long-term outcomes

 - Build and maintain the analyses, operating systems, and decision-making frameworks that guide company strategy and resource allocation

 - Partner closely with engineering, product, and operations teams to design new workflows, launch new capabilities, and leverage AI to increase scale and effectiveness

 - Explore, evaluate, and execute on new opportunities for the company, including strategic partnerships, new products and services, and expansion into new markets

 - Drive cross-functional projects that require alignment across multiple teams and stakeholders

 - Work closely with the rest of our team and CEO to make business decisions as we balance speed of growth and long-term profitability

 - Experience working on a team that required analytical problem-solving, operational rigor, and outcome ownership (e.g., fast-growing startup, consulting, finance, a 0 -> 1 business line at a high-performing organization)

Forus is building an AI-powered network that connects doctors, pharmacies, payers, and biopharma to accelerate new science to patients.

You will work directly with the General Counsel and teams across the company. You will tackle complex healthcare, privacy, AI, and data-use questions, pairing strong judgment with practical execution.

Forus is at a pivotal point. Our network, partnerships, products, and use of AI are expanding rapidly. The compliance and privacy foundations we build now will shape how the company scales and how clients trust us. This is a demanding role, with a high level of autonomy and responsibility. You will be expected to "act like an owner" and commit yourself to Forus' success. If you are low-ego, hungry to learn, and excited about intense, impactful work that drives both company growth and accelerated career progression, we want to hear from you.

 - Own Forus’s OIG-aligned healthcare compliance program to support our operations and maintain the client and partner trust that is essential to our business.

 - Oversee Forus’s privacy and HIPAA compliance programs, including policies, workforce training, minimum-necessary practices, and partnership with Security on technical controls.

 - Operationalize compliance requirements and own the policy, training, monitoring, and remediation cycles, and provide practical day-to-day guidance to the business.

 - Lead all aspects of compliance incident response including investigations, risk and breach assessments, remediation, and trend analysis.

 - Partner with functions including Legal, Security, Clinical, and Engineering on annual enterprise risk assessments and additional audits and certification processes.

 - Co-own AI and data use governance, including risk assessment, human oversight, testing, monitoring, incident response, vendor diligence, and clear reporting to leadership.

 - 10+ years of compliance, privacy, legal, or regulatory experience, including meaningful hands-on ownership of a compliance program.

 - Ideally, 5+ years of healthcare compliance experience spanning HIPAA/HITECH, fraud and abuse, investigations, monitoring, policies, and corrective action.

 - Outstanding written and verbal communication that enables you to translate complex compliance requirements into strategic and actionable guidance.

 - Track record of moving quickly, finding shortcuts, and going to unreasonable lengths to deliver on goals.
